description: This file defines a PHP class 'TemplateCurrencyId' that extends 'TemplateId'. It represents a currency ID field template within the SuiteCRM system, including methods to get field definitions, save, and delete the field. Additionally, it includes license information and security checks against direct access.

classes.name: TemplateCurrencyId
classes.description: A CRM field template class for handling currency ID fields, extending from TemplateId with custom properties and methods for definition, saving, and deletion.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array including type, database type, visibility in studio, and associated function for currency dropdown HTML.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the field only if it does not already exist in the given definition factory.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the field only if no other currency fields exist, preventing deletion if related data is present.
